```{r setup}
#| include: false

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```

```{r packages}
#| include: false

# load R packages 
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(conflicted)
library(psych)

# declare preferences regarding conflicts 
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)

```

```{r housekeeping}
#| include: false

# read scoring master file
data <- read_xlsx("../../data/raw/metamethod review/master coding/codebook_procedure_master.xlsx")
samples <- read_xlsx("../../data/raw/metamethod review/master coding/codebook_categorizations.xlsx")

```

```{r functions}
#| include: false

# Defining functions used in this script

# function 1: overview over a variable
overview_variable <- function(data, variable) {
  data %>%
    select(all_of(variable)) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(variable))) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 2))
}

```

```{r data preparation}
#| include: false

# reduce data frame to one line per article
data <- data %>%
  distinct(article_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# select relevant variables from data frame samples
samples <- samples %>% 
  select(article_id, category, info)

# join data with samples 
data <- data %>% 
  left_join(samples, by = "article_id")  

# create dataframe with clinical studies
data_clin <- data %>%
  filter(category == "1")

# create dataframe with non-clinical studies
data_non_clin <- data %>%
  filter(category != "1")

```


## Whole Sample
### Years of Publication
```{r}
#| echo: false

# get an overview over publications years
publ_years <- overview_variable(data, "year")
print(publ_years)

# range of publication years
range_publ_years <- publ_years %>%
  summarise(
    min_year = min(as.numeric(year), na.rm = TRUE),
    max_year = max(as.numeric(year), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
print(range_publ_years)

```

### Sample Sizes
```{r}
#| echo: false

# select sample_size and prepare for analysis 
sample_sizes <- data %>%
  select(sample_size) %>%
  filter(sample_size != "indeterminable") %>%
  unlist() %>%
  as.integer()

# summary of sample sizes across all studies
describe(sample_sizes)

```


## Clinical Studies 
### Years of Publication
```{r}
#| echo: false

# number of clinical publications
count_clin <- nrow(data_clin)

# get an overview over publications years
publ_years_clin <- overview_variable(data_clin, "year")
print(publ_years_clin)

# range of publication years
range_publ_years_clin <- publ_years_clin %>%
  summarise(
    min_year = min(as.numeric(year), na.rm = TRUE),
    max_year = max(as.numeric(year), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
print(range_publ_years_clin)

```

### Sample Sizes
```{r}
#| echo: false
```

### Clinical Samples
```{r}
#| echo: false

# get an overview over sample sizes
patient_groups <- overview_variable(data_clin, "info") %>%
  arrange(info)
print(patient_groups)

```
